_scope: Curated v1 subset using the full-book schema. Every field a full catalog needs is present; only the number of rows is reduced. Adding rows later needs no schema change.

completePackageBudgets.fashionNote: The 800eb may ONLY buy Fashion or Fashionware. Anything unspent is lost.

_rules.humanityLossAtCreation: At Character Generation, Humanity Loss is the PRESET flat number. The dice in parentheses apply only AFTER creation. Do not roll HL during chargen.
_rules.installNote: Installation surgery is always included at no extra charge, including at Character Generation.

cyberarm.notes: Ships with a Standard Hand that costs no Humanity and no slot.

cyberleg.notes: Ships with a Standard Foot that costs no Humanity and no slot.

optionSlots.nonFoundational: Fashionware, Internal Cyberware, and External Cyberware have no foundational piece, but a Character may still only implant 7 Option Slots worth of each category.
optionSlots.default: Unless otherwise marked, a cyberware option consumes 1 Option Slot in its foundation.
optionSlots._resolves: This closes the previously-open question about foundation slot counts.

_rules.armorNote: One worn armor per location (head / body / shield). Track current SP separately from base SP so ablation works in play.
_rules.stackingNote: Benefits from multiple installations of the same cyberware do not stack unless stated.

weapons.name: Air Pistol
weapons.notes: Exotic Medium Pistol firing paintballs (no damage). Filled with Acid, each hit lowers the shot location's armor SP by 1. Cannot cause Critical Injuries. Great for taking someone alive.

weapons.name: Battleglove
weapons.notes: Exotic heavy gauntlet with 3 Cyberarm option slots you can access while worn. Putting it on or taking it off is an Action. Cannot be concealed.

weapons.name: Constitution Arms Hurricane Assault Weapon
weapons.notes: Exotic 2 ROF Shotgun. No Aimed Shots. 16-shot drum, reload takes two Actions. Requires BODY 11+ to fire unmounted.

weapons.name: Dartgun
weapons.notes: Exotic Very Heavy Pistol that loads only Non-Basic Arrow ammunition, in an 8-round clip. Reloads like a Very Heavy Pistol.

weapons.name: Flamethrower
weapons.notes: Exotic Shotgun fired with Heavy Weapons. Fires only incendiary shotgun shells; ignited targets take 4 HP per turn until they put themselves out. No Aimed Shots, no Critical Injuries.

weapons.name: Kendachi Mono-Three
weapons.notes: Excellent Quality Two-Handed Exotic Very Heavy Melee weapon. With the correct biometric key, ignores armor entirely below SP11. A vibrating crystal katana; a laser can be set in the hilt for a neon glow.

weapons.name: Malorian Arms 3516
weapons.notes: Excellent Quality Exotic Very Heavy Pistol dealing 5d6 on a single shot, with a permanently installed Smartgun Link (needs Interface Plugs or a Subdermal Grip). Rare and coveted.

weapons.name: Microwaver
weapons.notes: Exotic Very Heavy Pistol. No damage: on a hit the target must beat a DV15 Cybertech Check or the GM shuts down two of their cyberware or electronics for a minute. Battery: 8 shots, spare packs 50eb.

weapons.name: Militech "Cowboy" U-56 Grenade Launcher
weapons.notes: Exotic 2 ROF Grenade Launcher holding 4 grenades and able to fire all Grenade Ammunition. Reload takes two Actions. Requires BODY 11+ to fire unmounted.

weapons.name: Rhinemetall EMG-86 Railgun
weapons.notes: Exotic Assault Rifle fired with Heavy Weapons. No Autofire, no Aimed Shots. Holds 4 shots and ignores armor below SP11. Reload takes two Actions. Requires BODY 11+ unmounted.

weapons.name: Shrieker
weapons.notes: Exotic Very Heavy Pistol. No damage: on a hit the target must beat a DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or suffer Damaged Ear. Firing it without ear protection damages your own ear. Battery: 8 shots.

weapons.name: Stun Baton
weapons.notes: One-Handed Exotic Medium Melee weapon. Non-lethal: a target it would drop below 1 HP is left Unconscious at 1 HP instead. No Critical Injuries, no armor ablation.

weapons.name: Stun Gun
weapons.notes: Exotic Heavy Pistol. Non-lethal: a target it would drop below 1 HP is left Unconscious at 1 HP instead. No Critical Injuries, no armor ablation. Battery: 8 shots, spare packs 50eb.

weapons.name: Tsunami Arms Helix
weapons.notes: Exotic Assault Rifle fired only with Autofire, no single shot or Aimed Shots. Holds 40 rounds and burns 20 per attack; on a hit, 2d6 multiplied by how much you beat the DV (max x5). Requires BODY 11+ unmounted.

armor.name: Kevlar
armor.notes: Can be made into clothes, vests, jackets, suits.

armor.name: Light Armorjack
armor.notes: Kevlar and plastic mesh in the weave.

armor.name: Bodyweight Suit
armor.notes: Stores a Cyberdeck and supports Interface Plugs.

armor.name: Bulletproof Shield
armor.notes: 10 HP reduced by damage. Always occupies one arm.

ammunition.name: Basic Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Grenades and Rockets are not sold as Basic ammunition.

ammunition.name: Armor-Piercing Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Ablate armor by 2 instead of 1 whenever you would ablate armor.

ammunition.name: Biotoxin Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Deals no damage. A meat target must beat a DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or take 3d6 straight to HP, armor unablated.

ammunition.name: EMP Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Deals no damage. Target must beat a DV15 Cybertech Check or the GM shuts down two pieces of their cyberware or carried electronics for 1 minute.

ammunition.name: Expansive Ammunition
ammunition.notes: On a Foreign Object Critical Injury, the target rolls a second Critical Injury and suffers it too (no bonus damage).

ammunition.name: Flashbang Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Deals no damage. Target must beat a DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or suffer Damaged Eye and Damaged Ear for a minute.

ammunition.name: Incendiary Ammunition
types: Arrows, Bullets, Grenades, and Shotgun Shells
ammunition.notes: Deal damage through armor and the target ignites: 2 HP at the end of each of their turns until they spend an Action to put it out. Does not stack.

ammunition.name: Poison Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Deals no damage. A meat target must beat a DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or take 2d6 straight to HP, armor unablated.

ammunition.name: Rubber Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Cannot cause Critical Injuries and cannot ablate armor. Never drops a target with more than 1 HP below 1 HP.

ammunition.name: Sleep Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Deals no damage. A meat target must beat a DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or drop Prone and Unconscious for a minute (or until woken or damaged).

ammunition.name: Smart Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Requires Targeting Scope cyberware to fire. A single shot that misses by 4 or less gets a second chance to hit at +10 on the die.

ammunition.name: Smoke Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Fills a 10m by 10m area with smoke for a minute on impact. Tasks attempted in it take a -4.

ammunition.name: Teargas Ammunition
ammunition.notes: Deals no damage. A target with meat eyes must beat a DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or suffer Damaged Eye for a minute.

cyberware.name: Biomonitor
cyberware.notes: Subdermal vitals readout. Links to an Agent.

cyberware.name: Chemskin
cyberware.notes: Permanently changes skin hue. +2 Personal Grooming with Techhair.

cyberware.name: EMP Threading
cyberware.notes: Silver circuit-pattern lines across the body.

cyberware.name: Light Tattoo
cyberware.notes: +2 Wardrobe & Style with three or more tattoos.

cyberware.name: Neural Link
cyberware.notes: Required for Neuralware and Subdermal Grip.

cyberware.name: Braindance Recorder
cyberware.notes: Records the user's experiences to a memory chip or external device.

cyberware.name: Chipware Socket
cyberware.notes: A socket in the back of the neck. Required to use Chipware.

cyberware.name: Interface Plugs
cyberware.notes: Plugs in wrist or head allowing connection to machines.

cyberware.name: Kerenzikov
cyberware.notes: Speedware. +2 Initiative. Only one Speedware at a time.

cyberware.name: Sandevistan
cyberware.notes: Speedware. +3 Initiative for one minute, 1 hour cooldown. Only one Speedware at a time.

cyberware.name: Chemical Analyzer
cyberware.notes: Tests a substance for chemical composition against a database.

cyberware.name: Olfactory Boost
cyberware.notes: Track by scent using the Tracking Skill.

cyberware.name: Cybereye
cyberware.notes: Artificial eye. Each Cybereye has 3 Option Slots. Many options must be paired across two eyes.

cyberware.name: Cyberaudio Suite
cyberware.notes: Has 3 Option Slots. Cannot install more than one.

cyberware.name: Cyberarm
cyberware.notes: Replacement arm. Ships with a Standard Hand that costs no Humanity and no slot.

cyberware.name: Cyberleg
cyberware.notes: Replacement leg. Ships with a Standard Foot that costs no Humanity and no slot.

_scopeNote: Weapons (standard and Exotic), armor, the full ammunition-type table, the full gear list, the fashion price grid, and a curated cyberware set. Covers Night Market shopping at Character Generation. Weapon Attachments are an in-play upgrade system, handled separately.

gear.name: Radar Detector

gear.name: Radio Communicator

gear.name: Radio Scanner/Music Player

gear.name: Road Flare

gear.name: Rope (60m/yd)

gear.name: Scrambler/Descrambler

gear.name: Smart Glasses

gear.name: Tech Bag

gear.name: Techscanner

gear.name: Techtool

gear.name: Tent and Camping Equipment

gear.name: Vial of Biotoxin

gear.name: Vial of Poison

gear.name: Video Camera
gear.description: Record up to 12 hours of audio and video on a single memory chip.

gear.name: Virtuality Goggles
gear.description: Projects cyberspace imagery over real world view.

fashion._note: Fashion is priced per garment slot per style. A character buys individual pieces (e.g. Leisurewear Jacket at 100eb), which is how the printed Streetrat/Edgerunner outfit strings decompose.
fashion._budgetRule: Fashion and Fashionware share the separate 800eb Complete Package budget. Unspent fashion money is LOST.
